notizie.titolo: The EBA publishes updated information on third-country groups and branches operating in the EU/EEA
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published its 2026 update on third-country groups and third-country branches operating in the European Union and the European Economic Area (EU/EEA). The publication provides a comprehensive overview of the presence, ownership structures and organisational arrangements of third-country banking groups active across the EU/EEA, supporting transparency in the European banking sector.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: EU/EEA banks continue to display resilience amid sovereign debt pressures, borrower vulnerabilities and rising cyber threats
notizie.descrizione: The EBA today published its Autumn 2026 Risk Assessment Report (RAR) together with a thematic note on lending to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and the results of its Autumn 2026 Risk Assessment Questionnaire (RAQ). The findings show that EU/EEA banks remain resilient, supported by strong capital, liquidity and profitability, while continuing to increase financing to the economy. At the same time, geopolitical uncertainty, sensitivity to sovereign debt repricing, growing interconnectedness within the financial sector and evolving operational threats warrant continued vigilance.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: ​The EBA reports growing market share of third-country bank subsidiaries in the EU and reduced foreign currency mismatches
notizie.descrizione: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published two Reports on the market share of subsidiaries of non-EU banks in the EU, as well as on EU banks’ assets and liabilities in foreign currencies. As of December 2025, subsidiaries of third country banking groups accounted for 10.22% of total EU banking assets, up from 9.8% a year earlier. The Reports also show that EU banks increased foreign currency funding to 25.3% of total funding, up from 24.8% as of December 2024, helping to reduce currency mismatches and largely eliminate the mismatch in US dollar positions.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance
notizie.descrizione: The EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance, as a key step towards a more efficient and resilient European banking system.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: ​The EBA supports the NGFS Declaration on the macro-financial dimension of the energy transition on the occasion of COP31
notizie.descrizione: ​As an active member of the Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS), the European Banking Authority (EBA) welcomes the publication of the NGFS Declaration on the macro-financial dimension of the energy transition on the occasion of the 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye. The Declaration highlights how energy price shocks and increasingly frequent climate-related shocks are becoming a macro-financial reality, and calls for an orderly, whole-economy transition.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA streamlines the 2027 EU-wide stress test with more than 55% reduction in requested data
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today released the final methodology, draft templates, and template guidance for its 2027 EU-wide stress test, together with the key milestones for the exercise. Following extensive engagement with industry participants, the EBA has significantly streamlined the exercise, reducing the number of required data points by 55% through the simplification of reporting templates and closer alignment with supervisory reporting. These changes will reduce operational burden and improve efficiency while preserving the robustness, risk-sensitivity and comparability of stress test results. notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA publishes consumer factsheet on white-labelled financial products and services
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a factsheet to help consumers identify when a banking or payment product or service is white labelled, i.e. marketed under one brand but provided by another company. As consumers increasingly access financial products and services through online platforms, retailers and other non-financial brands, it may be sometimes unclear which company is responsible for providing the product or service. Understanding this distinction can help consumers make informed decisions, know who they are dealing with and reduce risks. For this reason, the factsheet also guides consumers on the key things to know and check before getting that product or service.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA outlines next steps on supervisory reporting simplification and extends implementation timelines following consultation feedback on the ITS
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today outlines the way forward for the finalisation of proposals to simplify EU supervisory reporting, following extensive dialogue with the banking industry and feedback received during the public consultation. The package that is currently being finalised will introduce additional simplification measures, greater proportionality and extended implementation timelines, reducing reporting costs while preserving the information necessary for effective supervision. The final report on the draft Implementing Technical Standards (ITS) on supervisory reporting will be published by the EBA in December 2026.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA publishes revised Guidelines on internal governance, delivering greater proportionality and simplification for banks
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its revised Guidelines on internal governance under the Capital Requirements Directive (CRD). The revised Guidelines reflect the changes introduced by CRD VI and form part of the EBA’s broader commitment to simplify the regulatory framework, strengthen proportionality and reduce unnecessary compliance burdens, while safeguarding sound and robust governance across the EU banking sector.

notizie.feed: EBA - news
notizie.titolo: The EBA advises on targeted simplifications to Taxonomy disclosures
notizie.descrizione: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published its response to the European Commission’s Call for Technical Advice on certain key performance indicators (KPIs) and other aspects of the Disclosures Delegated Act under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation. The EBA advises on targeted changes to streamline disclosure requirements, reduce complexity and enhance the usability of information disclosed by credit institutions and investment firms.
